reuse.why: Hooks the new check into the existing refuseIfAlreadyLinked wrapper that every provider's link method already goes through, next to assertBankAccountNotLinked in link.ts.

duplication.why: One assertion function called from one wrapper; nothing is repeated per provider.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/link.ts beside the existing link precondition and is applied in the shared wrapper before any provider-specific work.

scope.why: Assertion, one call, tests and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Clean and central; the wrapper's name refuseIfAlreadyLinked no longer describes everything it checks, which a maintainer may want renamed.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six *-accounts-link methods are registered through refuseIfAlreadyLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the new check is a single function.

one_place.where: link.assertUpgradingAccountNotClosed, called once in refuseIfAlreadyLinked (accounts/app.ts), which wraps every provider's link handler.
